title: Lantbrukskunnig Innehållsproducent med fokus på film
description:
*Vill du använda film, berättande och möten med människor för att göra kunskap användbar för svensk animalieproduktion? Trivs du lika bra ute på en gård som framför redigeringsdatorn? Då kan det här vara en tjänst för dig!*

**Om Kunskapsnav Animalieproduktion**  

Kunskapsnav Animalieproduktion arbetar för att stärka produktivitet, lönsamhet och konkurrenskraft inom svensk animalieproduktion. Inom enheten är vi 16 medarbetare med bred och kompletterande kompetens inom bland annat kommunikation, animalieproduktion, veterinärmedicin och företagsekonomi. Genom att sammanställa, tillgängliggöra och sprida relevant kunskap till lantbrukare och rådgivare bidrar vi till en robust och konkurrenskraftig svensk livsmedelsproduktion.Du blir en del av en innovativ miljö där vi ständigt utvecklar nya sätt att göra kunskap tillgänglig och användbar för Sveriges lantbrukare**.**

**Om rollen**  

Vi söker en innehållsproducent som vill vara ute där det händer. En stor del av arbetet handlar om att besöka lantbruk, träffa djurägare och rådgivare, fånga erfarenheter från vardagen och omvandla dem till filmer och annat innehåll som inspirerar och skapar nytta för branschen. Hos oss får du kombinera kreativt innehållsskapande med ett genuint intresse för människor, praktiskt lantbruk och kunskapsutveckling.

**Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:**

* Planera, filma och redigera kunskapsfilmer.
* Genomföra intervjuer och dokumentera praktiska exempel.
* Skapa innehåll för webb, sociala medier och digitala utbildningar.
* Producera fotografier, presentationer, infografik och kortare texter.
* Medverka vid mässor och andra branschevenemang.
* Bidra till utvecklingen av nya kunskapsprojekt och digitala format.


Placering är Lund eller Uppsala. Vi utgår idag från ett hybridarbetssätt där det går att dela sin arbetstid mellan kontoret och hemarbetsplatsen. Resor är en naturlig del av rollen och förekommer regelbundet.

**Vem är du?**  

För att lyckas i rollen är du nyfiken, kreativ och självgående. Du tycker om att möta människor och har lätt för att skapa förtroende. Du ser berättelser och kunskap i människors vardag och kan omsätta det till innehåll som engagerar och skapar nytta.Du är strukturerad, tar ansvar för hela produktionen och trivs med att växla mellan självständigt arbete och nära samarbete med andra.


Krav för rollen:

* Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom film, journalistik, media, kommunikation eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet.
* Erfarenhet av filmproduktion, från planering och intervju till redigering och publicering.
* Goda kunskaper i Adobe Premiere Pro eller motsvarande redigeringsverktyg.
* Erfarenhet av fotografering, ljudinspelning och produktion för digitala kanaler.
* Kunskap och erfarenhet inom lantbruk, animalieproduktion eller andra gröna näringar.
* God förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift.
* B-körkort och möjlighet att resa regelbundet i tjänsten.


Meriterande:

* Erfarenhet av journalistiskt arbete, intervjuteknik eller reportageproduktion.
* Erfarenhet av kunskapsförmedling, utbildningsproduktion eller forskningskommunikation.
* Erfarenhet av tillgänglighetsanpassning och textning av digitalt innehåll.
* Kunskaper i ytterligare verktyg inom Adobe Creative Cloud.
* Erfarenhet av webbpublicering, livesändningar, webbinarier eller AI-baserade produktionsverktyg.

**Är vi en bra match?**  

Hos oss är du inte bara innehållsproducent. Du är också med och utvecklar framtidens kunskapsförmedling för svensk animalieproduktion. Du får stor frihet att testa nya idéer, utforska nya format och bidra till projekt som gör verklig skillnad för lantbrukare, rådgivare och andra aktörer i branschen. Arbetet är varierat, kreativt och utvecklande, med ena foten i den digitala världen och den andra ute på gårdar runt om i landet.

**Välkommen med din ansökan!**  

Låter detta intressant och du vill du veta mer är du välkommen att kontakta Kristina Yngwe, Enhetschef Kunskapsnav animalieproduktion, kristina.yngwe@ri.se. Sista ansökningsdag är 12 november. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande under och efter ansökningsperioden. Sök utan personligt brev.


Våra fackliga representanter är Ingemar Petermann, Saco, 010 228 41 22 och Linda Ikatti, Unionen, 010-5165161.

title: MARKETING AUTOMATION SPECIALIST
description:
City: Solna
**About the role**
------------------


Do you love turning data into personalized experiences at scale? Are you someone who gets excited by a well-timed journey, a clean segment, and a test that teaches you something? If so, this might be exactly the right next step.

  

As a Marketing Automation Specialist at SAS, you will independently own and evolve automated customer journeys and omnichannel communication flows – driving sales, loyalty and customer experience through data-driven, personalized engagement and marketing automation across email, SMS, push and beyond.


**Challenges you will work on:**
--------------------------------


* Design, build and continuously optimize automated customer journeys in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, leveraging data and audience insights to drive relevance, customer value and conversion.
* Execute calendar-based emails, SMS and push communication in line with the marketing plan.
* Configure audience segmentation and selection with data-driven logic to reach the right customer at the right time, using customer insights and behavioral data to improve relevance and engagement.
* Design and execute A/B and multivariate testing strategies, translating results into actionable journey improvements and campaign optimization opportunities.
* Collaborate with CRM Specialists to ensure relevant and personalized content, and act as an internal specialist on journey automation best practices, contributing to how the team evolves its ways of working and marketing automation tooling over time.
**The Team**
------------


You will be part of the Performance Management team, working closely with CRM Specialists, a Senior MA Specialist, and Paid Digital Marketing Specialists, and collaborating with Analytics, CRM IT, Digital Sales and e-Commerce.

  

It's a team that values data, and genuine curiosity about what the next generation of marketing tools can do. We combine strong specialist expertise with collaboration, continuous learning and knowledge sharing, always striving to improve customer experience and marketing performance.


**To be successful we believe you have**
----------------------------------------


You have a structured and detail-oriented approach, a strong commercial mindset, and a genuine curiosity about MarTech, data, and customer experience. You are comfortable taking ownership of your work, working independently when needed, and collaborating effectively with colleagues and stakeholders across teams.


* Hands-on experience within marketing automation or CRM, including building, managing, and optimizing customer journeys end-to-end.
* Experience working with Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
* Strong understanding of segmentation, customer journeys, personalization, and lifecycle marketing.
* Experience with A/B testing, campaign performance analysis, and continuous optimization.
* Familiarity with AI-powered workflows and automation tools used to improve efficiency, testing, and campaign execution.
  

It’s a bonus if you also have experience from:


* Additional platforms (e.g. Adobe Campaign, Oracle Eloqua, Braze or similar)
* Working with or alongside a CDP implementation – you don’t need to have built it, but you should understand how unified customer profiles and real-time data can power journey logic.
**Why SAS?**
------------


At SAS, we offer extensive opportunities for professional development in an international, fast-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including:

  

* Travel Perks: Enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS.
* Health & Wellness: Access to health and wellness benefits, including a newly renovated gym with complimentary classes such as CrossFit and yoga.
* Discounts: Receive discounts from a wide range of brands, as well as on transportation to and from airports, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals.
* Work Environment: Our office location in Frösundavik offers a vibrant workspace with a restaurant, café, and easy access to outdoor activities in Hagaparken and Brunnsviken. Engage in running, tennis, outdoor gym sessions, kayaking, and stand-up paddling with equipment available free of charge.
* Convenient Commute: Benefit from a non-stop bus service connecting our office to Solna station, and commuter trains, alongside a network of cycle paths.
**Our Culture at SAS**
----------------------


At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you’ll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!


**Additional information**
--------------------------


Deadline for application: 12/11/2026. Please send us your CV as soon as possible, as interviews are conducted continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Note that we are not able to handle any applications that are sent by email, due to GDPR regulations.


* Position: Fulltime (100%) starting with a 6-month probation period
* This position is based in Frösundavik, Solna (Stockholm), and is primarily office-based. Any work-from-home arrangements must be agreed with your manager. SAS encourages employees to work primarily from the office to support collaboration, teamwork, and business needs.
* To be eligible for this position you need an EU-work permit. Please note that we ask you to inform us if you currently have a valid EU-work permit.
* A background check will be conducted at the final stage of this recruitment process, as this role is security classified. If you, are aware of any specific matters that may come up during this background check, we kindly ask you to be transparent about them during the recruitment process.

Our mission is to connect Scandinavia with the world and the world with Scandinavia. Each year, SAS serves more than 25 million passengers and transports 55 tons of cargo to 135 destinations across Europe, the USA, and Asia. With a passionate workforce of over 10,000 colleagues, we collaborate with partners and customers to drive transformative changes in aviation. title: Kommunikatör
description:
Kunskapsförbundet Väst Kunskapsförbundet har en central roll för elevernas framtidslust - vi guidar dem till att nå sina mål och bli redo för morgondagen, som medmänniskor, medarbetare och medborgare. Tillsammans skapar vi möjligheter och utrymme att utvecklas i våra professionella roller med strävan om att alltid leverera hög kvalité. Vi värdesätter engagemang, ansvar och kreativitet, och vi tror att du gör detsamma. Kom och bli en del av oss!

*Kunskapsförbundet är en utbildningsaktör i Trollhättan och Vänersborg som har både Vuxenutbildning och tre gymnasieskolor Magnus Åbergsgymnasiet, Nils Ericsonsgymnasiet och Birger Sjöberggymnasiet. Här jobbar närmare 700 medarbetare som alla har samma mål - att våra elever ska växa och känna framtidslust. Och bli så mycket de kan.*

**Hej Kommunikatör**!


Vill du leda, utveckla och stärka kommunikationen i en organisation med ett viktigt samhällsuppdrag? Hos Kunskapsförbundet Väst får du en central roll i att utveckla vårt varumärke, stötta verksamheten i kommunikationsfrågor och bidra till att nå våra mål genom strategisk och operativ kommunikation.


På kommunikationsavdelning arbetar du tillsammans med två kommunikatörer och en kommunikationschef. Vi leder, samordnar och utvecklar förbundets kommunikationsarbete och är ett stöd till hela organisationen. Vi ansvarar för intern och extern kommunikation, marknadsföring och varumärkesarbete för Kunskapsförbundet Väst och våra olika skolor.


Rollen innebär nära samverkan med rektorer, lärare, förbundsledning och andra specialistfunktioner, vilket ger dig stora möjligheter att påverka och bidra till verksamhetens utveckling.

**Vad ska du göra?**


Som kommunikatör hos oss kommer du att:

* fungera som strategiskt och operativt kommunikationsstöd till chefer och verksamheter
* planera, processleda och genomföra kommunikations- och marknadsföringsinsatser
* stötta organisationen i kommunikativ planering, budskapsformulering och kanalval
* producera innehåll för webb, sociala medier, intranät och tryckt material
* skriva, redigera och kvalitetssäkra texter för olika målgrupper
* arbeta med foto, film och grafisk formgivning
* utveckla och förvalta webb och intranät
* medverka vid event och aktiviteter som gynnar varumärket
* följa upp och analysera kommunikationsinsatser
* samverka med externa leverantörer och samarbetspartners


Som resurs för innehållsskapande har kommunikationsavdelningen en fullt utrustad studio för filmproduktion, fotografering, poddar och livesändningar.

**Vem är du?**


Du är en kommunikativ och relationsskapande person som trivs i en rådgivande roll och har lätt för att skapa förtroende hos olika målgrupper.


Du har ett strategiskt synsätt på kommunikation och förstår hur kommunikation kan bidra till verksamhetsutveckling, engagemang och ett starkt varumärke. Samtidigt tycker du om att omsätta idéer till konkreta aktiviteter och innehåll.


Vi tror också att du:

* har erfarenhet av att stötta och vägleda chefer och verksamheter i kommunikationsfrågor
* är en skicklig skribent med god känsla för målgruppsanpassad kommunikation
* har kunskap inom grafisk form, layout och visuell kommunikation
* arbetar strukturerat, självständigt och med god prioriteringsförmåga
* trivs med att samarbeta med många olika yrkesroller

**Kvalifikationer:**

* Högskoleutbildning inom kommunikation, medie- och kommunikationsvetenskap, marknadsföring eller motsvarande.
* Några års erfarenhet av kvalificerat kommunikationsarbete, exempelvis som kommunikatör, kommunikationsstrateg eller marknadsförare.
* Erfarenhet av Adobe Creative Cloud
* Erfarenhet av Microsoft 365

### **Meriterande**

* Erfarenhet av kommunikationsarbete inom skola eller utbildning
* Erfarenhet av WordPress
* Erfarenhet av Canva
* Produktion i studio- eller inspelningsmiljö
* Efterbearbetning av film, foto eller ljud
* Sitevision
* AI-verktyg för kommunikationsarbete

### **Övrigt**


Körkort är ett krav.


Kunskapsförbundet tillämpar individuell och differentierad lönsättning. Lönen fastställs utifrån utbildning, erfarenhet, ansvar och kompetens. För tjänsten som Kommunikatör är lönespannet idag 38 000 kr - 45 300 kr.  


Vid erbjudande om tjänst kommer du behöva uppvisa ett utdrag från misstanke- och belastningsregistret. Detta utdrag beställer du själv via polisen, https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/skola-eller-forskola/ När du söker ett jobb hos oss sparas din ansökan. Det beror på att vi är en offentlig verksamhet. Din ansökan blir en allmän handling när vi har mottagit den. Det innebär att ansökningshandlingar och information om vem som sökt en tjänst kan begäras ut. Om du har skyddad identitet ska du inte göra din ansökan digitalt utan kontakta den som står som kontaktperson i annonsen. Arbetstillstånd ska uppvisas om du är ifrån ett land utanför EU/EES eller Schweiz. Vi omfattas av kollektivavtal (Kollektivavtal - Allmänna bestämmelser) och tillämpar de villkor och bestämmelser som följer av avtalet. Kunskapsförbundet tillämpar individuell och differentierad lönesättning. Lönen baseras på sakliga kriterier såsom utbildning, erfarenhet, ansvar och kompetens. Som arbetsgivare arbetar vi aktivt med lönetransparens och jämställd lönesättning fri från osakliga löneskillnader. Vi behandlar personuppgifter enligt den nya Dataskyddsförordningen,Behandling av personuppgifter - Kunskapsförbundet Väst Vi undanber oss alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons.

title: AD / Grafisk designer till Finnvedens Bil i Varberg
description:
Kreativitet, storytelling och rörligt innehåll är det din grej? Nu söker vi en grafisk designer till Finnvedens Bil i Varberg! Här får du vara med och forma vårt visuella uttryck, förvandla idéer till engagerande innehåll och göra vårt varumärke ännu starkare.
  
Är du den som får idéer att komma till liv? Har du ett öga för design, en känsla för storytelling och att skapa innehåll som får människor att stanna upp?  



På Finnvedens Bil är vi mitt i en spännande utvecklingsresa där vi bygger ett starkare, gemensamt varumärke. Nu söker vi dig som vill vara med och påverka hur vi syns, kommunicerar och berättar om vår verksamhet. I rollen får du kombinera kreativ höjd med praktisk produktion. Ena dagen tar du fram ett kampanjkoncept, nästa dag klipper du en film, skapar innehåll för sociala medier eller lyfter fram människorna som jobbar hos oss.  



**Om rollen**


Som AD/grafisk designer blir du en viktig del av vår marknadsavdelning. Du arbetar brett med visuell kommunikation, med särskilt fokus på rörligt innehåll, och är med och formar hur Finnvedens Bil syns och upplevs i våra olika kanaler.  



Du arbetar nära dina kollegor på marknadsavdelningen och människorna ute i verksamheten. Tillsammans hittar ni idéerna, berättelserna och möjligheterna som stärker vårt varumärke och skapar engagemang.  



**Du kommer bland annat att:**


* Utveckla kreativa idéer, visuella koncept och kampanjmaterial som stärker vårt varumärke.
* Skapa och producera innehåll för våra digitala kanaler, med särskilt fokus på film, reels, animationer och rörlig grafik.
* Redigera film med känsla för storytelling, tempo, ljud, färg och textning.
* Formge material för sociala medier, annonser, trycksaker och våra anläggningar.
* Arbeta med bildredigering och anpassa innehåll efter olika målgrupper och kanaler.
* Bidra till ett enhetligt och igenkännbart visuellt uttryck utifrån vår grafiska profil.

Samarbeta med kollegor i verksamheten för att fånga och lyfta fram berättelserna som gör Finnvedens Bil till oss.  

* 

**Vem är du?**


Vi tror att du är en kreativ person med öga för detaljer, som är nyfiken på nya idéer och gillar att växla mellan kreativt tänkande och konkret produktion.


Du tar gärna egna initiativ, driver ditt arbete framåt och har förmågan att skapa struktur även när det är mycket på gång. Samtidigt tycker du om att samarbeta, lyssna in andras perspektiv och utveckla idéer tillsammans. Du vågar testa nytt, ser möjligheter och tycker att det är minst lika roligt att genomföra en idé som att komma på den.  



**Vi ser gärna att du:**


* Har minst 3-5 års erfarenhet av grafisk design och visuell innehållsproduktion.
* Har goda kunskaper i Adobe Creative Cloud, exempelvis InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro och After Effects, eller motsvarande verktyg.
* Har erfarenhet av filmredigering, animation och rörlig grafik.
* Förstår vad som skapar engagemang i sociala medier och hur innehåll anpassas efter kanal och målgrupp.
* Kan ta en kreativ produktion från idé till färdigt material.

Kan visa upp en portfolio eller arbetsprover som ger oss en bild av din kreativitet och ditt hantverk.  

* 

Har du dessutom erfarenhet av fotografering, filmning eller innehållsproduktion på plats i verksamheten är det ett extra plus.  



För oss är det också viktigt att du är nyfiken på människor. Vi tror nämligen att de bästa berättelserna ofta finns närmare än man tror, i vardagen, hos våra medarbetare och i mötet med våra kunder.  



**Vi erbjuder**


Hos Finnvedens Bil blir du en del av en arbetsplats där människor står i fokus. Vi vill att du ska trivas, utvecklas och känna stolthet i ditt arbete och vi arbetar aktivt för att du ska ha rätt förutsättningar att växa, oavsett var du befinner dig i din karriär.


Vi är i en spännande utvecklingsfas där nya idéer uppmuntras och där du har möjlighet att påverka. Samtidigt erbjuder vi tryggheten i en stabil organisation med kollektivavtal, bra villkor och förmåner.


Hos oss möts du av en stark gemenskap där vi stöttar varandra och arbetar tillsammans mot gemensamma mål.  



**Ansökan**


Skicka in ditt CV så snart som möjligt, senast den 28 november 2026. Istället för personligt brev ber vi dig att svara på några urvalsfrågor. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med placeringsort Varberg.


Vi arbetar löpande med urval och återkommer till dig så snart vi har möjlighet. Rekryteringen kan komma att avslutas innan sista ansökningsdag, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan.  



Vi ser fram emot att din ansökan rullar in – gärna med full fart

title: Data Foundation Expert
description:
**Are you an experienced data engineer or architect who knows a data foundation is more than a platform, and enjoys leading others to build one?**


At Curamando, you’ll design and deliver data foundations for AI-driven insights and activation. That means the platform, but also the data models, governance, ownership and teams around it. No two organisations need the same foundation, so you’ll fit each one to the client’s size, maturity and goals. We work across industries, with brands like McDonald’s and IKEA.


Data foundations are changing. Clients now want custom reporting apps and AI agents that answer business questions on their own. That puts more weight on strong data models, a semantic layer that gives people and AI the same definitions, and clear rules for what AI can access.


How we work is changing too. We’re quickly becoming AI-first, and you’ll help shape what that means for our team and our clients.


As a Data Foundation Expert, you’ll own workstreams, lead data engineers and work as an equal with client leadership, often on site.

### **What you’ll do**

* Assess a client’s data foundation and set the roadmap with their leadership
* Design and build cost-efficient cloud data platforms, choosing the architecture and tools that fit each client
* Define data models and semantic layers that AI agents and downstream applications can rely on
* Shape governance, ownership, security and access for both people and AI
* Help clients build the data team they need and decide where AI fits in their work
* Lead and mentor data engineers, guide architectural choices and take on the hardest technical problems
* Set standards for orchestration, CI/CD, testing, monitoring and infrastructure as code
* Work AI-first with coding agents, and shape how our team and clients use them, holding AI output to the same standard as their own
* Contribute to proposals, scoping and pitches, and help grow our Data Foundation team and offering

### **Who you are**


We believe you’re a good fit if you:

* Have many years’ experience building data platforms across different clouds and tools, including in a lead or architect role
* Have shaped governance, ownership and team setup in organisations of different sizes
* Have deep experience with data modelling and semantic layers
* Have led and coached data engineers, and enjoy helping people grow
* Still love to build and care about what you ship. Maybe coding agents got you hands-on again after years in engineering management
* Have strong Python and SQL skills
* Are a clear thinker who turns vague questions into a concrete plan and explains trade-offs to engineers and executives alike
* Have opinions on how AI is changing data foundations and engineering work, and the experience to back them up
* Communicate fluently in Swedish, both spoken and written
* Are based in Stockholm or open to relocating here

### **Why Curamando?**


Curamando is part of Eidra, a group of 16 companies with more than 1,400 specialists across cities from Stockholm to New York.


You’ll lead data foundation work for a range of clients and learn from experienced colleagues across Eidra. We value collaboration, curiosity and taking initiative, and believe in giving people responsibility and room to grow. We also believe in working together in person at our office in central Östermalm.

### **The recruitment process**


We want the recruitment process to give both you and us a chance to get to know each other and see if we’re a good match. The process consists of:

* **Introduction:** A first conversation of around 45 minutes to discuss your experience, motivations and what you’re looking for.
* **Technical interview and case:** You’ll present a short take-home case on how you’d shape a client’s data foundation. We’ll focus on your technical depth, your judgement and how you communicate your approach.
* **Team meet and greet:** An optional opportunity to meet the team, ask questions and get a feel for everyday life at Curamando and Eidra.


We review applications and invite candidates to interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Head of Customer Solutions
description:
**About Us**

**nShift** is the leading global provider of cloud delivery management solutions (SaaS), we enable the frictionless shipment and return of almost one billion shipments across 190 countries each year. We are headquartered in London and Oslo and have over 500 employees across offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Romania.


Our software is used by many of the world leading e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, and 3PL shippers due to us having over 1000 carriers integrated into our platform, nearly 3 times more than our competitors!

  

If you buy goods online, there is a strong chance that nShift has powered that delivery, so come and join us as we shape the future of shipping, one frictionless journey at a time.

**About you**

You have led customer-facing teams in B2B SaaS and know what separates real ownership from handoffs. You are commercially sharp and technically curious. You do not need to be a developer, but you can follow integrations, carrier requirements and shipping workflows well enough to coach your team and challenge scoping. You are calm under pressure, direct, and comfortable creating structure where ownership is unclear.

###### **Role purpose**


We are looking for a hands-on leader to build and run our Customer Solutions team. The team is a critical business partner between Sales/CS, Support, Product, Engineering and Professional Services, and helps customers, resellers and partners adopt, scale and get value from nShift, from early opportunity scoping with new customers to ongoing consultancy and solutions optimization for existing customers.

###### **What you will own:**

**Team leadership and development**

* Lead, coach and grow a team of Customer Solutions Managers / Pre-Sales Engineers, setting clear priorities and standards.
* Recruit, onboard and develop talent, and build a culture of accountability, curiosity and pace.
* Define the team’s operating model: account and resource allocation, coverage, workload balance, and handover points with Sales/CS, Professional Services and Support/Engineering.

**Pre-sales support and solution scoping**

* Ensure opportunities and implementations are well scoped before work starts: integrations, carriers, workflows, dependencies, risks and expected outcomes.
* Set scoping standards and discovery practices, and act as the quality gate on complex or strategic deals, RFPs and customer workshops.
* Partner with Sales leadership on deal strategy, so customers hear a consistent message on what is standard, what is possible and what requires additional work.

**Customer outcomes and enablement**

* Support Sales and CS on customer cases to drive adoption of more of the platform, including additional modules, features etc.
* Act as an internal orchestrator to ensure we deliver the right customer outcomes and drive Growth as well as CSAT
* Build relationships with key customers, resellers and partners.

###### **What success looks like:**

* Customers, resellers and partners know who to go to and trust the team to move things forward.
* Opportunities and implementations are better scoped, with fewer surprises after handover.
* New bookings, Adoption, retention and expansion improve measurably.
* Internal teams see Customer Solutions as a source of knowledge, solutions ownership and recommendations.
* The team is stable, engaged and developing, with strong performers staying.

###### **Experience and skills:**

* Proven experience leading customer-facing teams (Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solution Consulting, Professional Services or Implementation) in B2B SaaS, ideally including managers or senior individual contributors.
* Track record of improving retention, adoption and expansion through structure, coaching and clear accountability.
* Credibility with business and technical stakeholders across logistics, e-commerce, IT, operations, customer service and procurement.
* Good understanding of integrations, APIs, carrier services and shipping workflows, or similar environments.
* Strong commercial awareness: able to read renewal, churn and expansion signals and connect them to account strategy and forecasting.
* Experience building processes, metrics and operating rhythms (account reviews, scoping standards).
* Strong written and spoken communication, with the ability to simplify complex topics.
* Fluent English. Professional level Swedish and/or other Nordic language is an advantage.

**Ideal advantages**

* Experience in logistics, e-commerce, carriers, WMS, OMS, ERP, TMS, 3PLs or shipping software.
* Experience with reseller, partner or channel-led customer models.
* Pre-sales leadership: technical discovery, solution design, RFP/RFI support and customer workshops.
* Experience restructuring or scaling a customer-facing team.

###### **Personal profile**

* You lead through ownership: you expect it from your team and model it yourself.
* You are structured and proactive, and comfortable in fast-moving situations where roles are not perfectly defined.
* You coach rather than rescue, and you push for progress without creating noise.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:

Our solutions, including Hii Retail, our cloud-native unified commerce platform, connect checkout, pricing, promotions and online in one place, so retailers can keep evolving their stores and give their customers a better experience. We are driven by our mission to simplify shopping and our commitment to ensuring that current and future customers thrive in the highly competitive and rapidly changing retail industry.


As Product Marketing Manager you’ll shape how retailers understand and choose our solutions. You’ll be part of the marketing team, report to the Head of Marketing, and work closely with Product, Sales and Client Success to bring our products to market and make them a commercial success. The role is based at our head office in Stockholm.

* A strong understanding of software products, and the curiosity to learn how ours work and create value for retailers
* Confidence working with senior stakeholders, internally and with customers
* A structured, commercial way of working, and the drive to take ownership
* Fluent in Swedish and English, with excellent writing skills in both

#### **Nice to have**

* Experience as a copywriter or content writer
* Experience from retail, retail technology, POS or e-commerce
* Experience from an international B2B company

#### **Who you are**


You’re curious about how retail is changing and enjoy connecting product capabilities to business value. You like working with many teams, you’re comfortable both thinking strategically and getting things done, and you love to write.

#### **What we offer**

* A role with real impact on how Extenda Retail and Hii Retail are seen in the market
* A dedicated marketing team in an international company
* A hybrid setup based at our head office in Stockholm
* A vibrant office culture with themed events and activities like board game night, like running races, yoga in the office and group sessions at the gym
* A welcoming, inclusive culture built on our values of trust, care and innovation

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
**DESCRIPTION**

We're looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to take ownership of the platform that powers our data products, from real-time APIs our customers depend on to the batch pipelines behind our analytics. You'll work across a lambda architecture that combines a low-latency streaming layer built in Go with a batch layer on Google Cloud, running on infrastructure spread across AWS, Azure, and GCP in regions around the world.


This is a hands-on senior role with real technical leadership. Beyond building and maintaining the platform, you'll set the bar for engineering quality on the team, shape how we design services so they stay modular and scalable as we grow, and act as tech lead and mentor for junior engineers.


**Build and evolve the data platform**

* Develop and maintain our real-time layer, including the Go-based gateway and processing engine that serve customer-facing workloads with high availability and low latency.
* Own and improve the batch layer on GCP, working with BigQuery, Airflow, and dbt to deliver reliable, well-modelled, and cost-efficient pipelines.
* Keep the speed and batch layers consistent with each other, making sure data is correct, reconcilable, and trustworthy regardless of which path it takes.

**Design and ship customer-facing backend services**

* Design, build, and operate backend APIs that customers use directly, with strong attention to contracts, versioning, performance, and backwards compatibility.
* Think through failure modes, observability, and scaling up front, so services behave predictably in production.

**Own multi-cloud infrastructure**

* Manage and evolve our infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP in multiple global regions using Terraform.
* Improve how we structure infrastructure code through reusable modules, sensible environment separation, and safe, repeatable deployments.
* Drive improvements in monitoring, alerting, security, and cost visibility across clouds. Participate in a shared on-call rotation for production systems.

**Raise the bar on engineering excellence**

* Define and champion engineering standards around code quality, testing, code review, CI/CD, and documentation.
* Lead technical design discussions and write clear design documents for significant changes, bringing the team along in the reasoning.
* Identify technical debt and architectural weak points and build a pragmatic plan to address them alongside feature work.

**Lead and mentor**

* Serve as tech lead for the team, guiding technical direction and helping prioritize work (this role has no direct reports).
* Mentor two junior engineers through pairing, thoughtful code reviews, and gradually increasing ownership, helping them grow into confident, independent engineers.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* Significant professional experience as a software or data engineer (typically 6+ years), including time spent owning production systems end to end.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals: clean and modular design, testing strategies, API design, and an understanding of distributed systems trade-offs.
* Experience building and operating backend services in a compiled or typed language such as Go, Java, Kotlin, Rust, or similar.
* Hands-on experience with a modern data stack, ideally BigQuery, Airflow, and dbt or close equivalents.
* Solid experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform, and working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider in depth.
* Familiarity with both real-time/streaming and batch data processing patterns, and the challenges of combining them.
* A track record of mentoring others and raising the quality of the teams you've been part of.
* Clear written and verbal communication, especially the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to engineers of varying experience.

**Nice to have**

* Professional experience with Go. This is a strong plus, though we'll happily support an experienced backend engineer in going deep on it.
* Experience running infrastructure across multiple clouds and regions, including networking, identity, and data residency considerations.
* Background with lambda or kappa architectures, event streaming systems (such as Kafka or Pub/Sub), or high-throughput API gateways.
* Experience with observability tooling (metrics, tracing, logging) and cloud cost optimization.

Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English.


This is a hybrid role based in Stockholm, Sweden, and reporting to the Senior Engineering Manager.


Candidates must have the right to work in Sweden. Relocation and work permit sponsorship are not available for this role.


**OUR HIRING PROCESS**

We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.


We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/. No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!


**Salary** :


The monthly salary for this position is between 60 000 – 72 000 SEK. Factors which may affect pay within this range may include skills, education, experience, and other qualifications.

title: Director, Product Software Engineering
description:
Tax and accounting professionals across Scandinavia rely on our software every day to run their practices, serve their clients and stay compliant with constantly changing legislation. We are modernising that portfolio, evolving trusted solutions while building new cloud platforms, developing how our teams work together, and embracing AI across the product development lifecycle to empower our engineers and amplify their expertise.


We are looking for a **Director, Product Software Engineering** to lead our Scandinavian engineering organisation through this journey. You will lead a team of experienced managers, architects and engineers, building on a strong foundation to take delivery, engineering practices and the organisation to the next level, as part of a global Wolters Kluwer engineering community.

 **Why this role**

* **Real impact:** Shape what it means to bring software products to market in Scandinavia at the moment GenAI is changing how software is built.
* **A meaningful product:** Software that professionals depend on for compliance, accuracy and their own clients.
* **Great people:** A capable, committed and genuinely friendly team with deep domain expertise.
* **Local leadership, global reach:** Lead a Scandinavian organisation while representing it in global and regional forums within Wolters Kluwer.
* **Stability with ambition:** The long-term perspective of a global market leader, with a team actively transforming.

 **Your mandate**

  

You are accountable for the performance, results and health of product software engineering for Scandinavia. Reporting to the VP, Region North, you lead the engineering management team and work closely with product management, architecture, security and global engineering.

 **What you will do**  

  

**Deliver predictably**


Own delivery of the strategic roadmap. Keep a consolidated view of demand versus capacity, make trade-offs explicit before work starts, and validate that commitments are achievable.

**Set technology direction and investment**


Translate business strategy into technology priorities. Balance investment across new product development, modernisation, technical debt, compliance and operational resilience with a multi-year view, and challenge initiatives where the value does not justify the investment.

**Raise engineering effectiveness**


Use meaningful delivery and quality insights to help teams continuously improve how they work. Sponsor developer-experience improvements and modern, automated build, test, release and deployment practices.

**Lead the AI engineering transformation**


Champion AI-assisted and spec-driven development across the organisation, in line with security, privacy and governance requirements. Encourage experimentation, and keep looking for ways to simplify and accelerate how we work together.

**Safeguard quality, security and compliance**


Maintain quality, security and release-readiness standards. Act as primary owner for ISO 27001 within your area and keep the organisation prepared for upcoming regulation, particularly from the EU.

**Modernise release planning**


Together with our Release Manager, establish modern release planning with up-front coordination of dependencies across products and global teams, ensuring smooth updates for customers.

**Connect Scandinavia and global**


Represent Scandinavian engineering in global and regional forums, work within shared corporate standards and frameworks, and escalate constructively when global and local priorities conflict.

**Lead and grow people**

description:
BIM Specialist / BIM Manager OL31 Rail Project, Vagnhärad, Sweden Shape the future of Swedish infrastructure HOCHTIEF is one of the world's leading infrastructure and construction groups, employing approximately 38,000 people worldwide. We deliver complex projects across a wide range of sectors, including roads, bridges, tunnels, railways, airports, ports, buildings, and both conventional and renewable energy. With operations across Europe, North America, and the Asia-Pacific region, HOCHTIEF combines engineering expertise with innovative and sustainable solutions to shape the infrastructure of the future. We are currently looking for an BIM Specialist / BIM Manager to join our team on the OL31 Project in Vagnhärad, Sweden.
  
  

The OL31 Project forms part of the Ostlänken programme, one of Sweden's largest and most important railway infrastructure investments. Ostlänken is a new approximately 160-kilometre double-track railway connecting Järna and Linköping, designed to increase capacity, improve regional connectivity and support sustainable transport across Sweden. The project involves complex civil engineering works, including tunnels, bridges, earthworks and rail infrastructure. Working on OL31 offers the opportunity to contribute to a landmark infrastructure programme while supporting the recruitment and development of a diverse, international project organization.
  
  

About the Role As BIM Specialist / BIM Manager, you will be responsible for coordinating, developing and managing Building Information Modelling (BIM) processes across the project. You will support design, engineering and construction teams by ensuring effective use of digital models, data management systems and BIM workflows throughout the project lifecycle. The role requires a strong technical background, experience working with infrastructure projects and the ability to manage digital collaboration between designers, engineers, subcontractors and project stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Manage and coordinate BIM processes throughout the project lifecycle.
  
  

Develop, maintain and implement BIM Execution Plans (BEPs) and project BIM procedures. Ensure compliance with client BIM requirements, project specifications and industry standards. Coordinate multidisciplinary BIM models and perform clash detection. Manage model federation, review and issue resolution processes.
  
  

Support design and construction teams with BIM-related workflows and technical solutions. Facilitate coordination meetings and manage BIM collaboration between project stakeholders. Review and validate BIM models for quality, accuracy and constructability. Manage Common Data Environment (CDE) processes and digital document workflows.
  
  

Support the production of 3D, 4D and 5D BIM deliverables. Coordinate model updates and ensure consistency between design and construction information. Support as-built model development and project handover requirements. Train and support project personnel on BIM tools, procedures and best practices.
  
  

Monitor BIM performance and recommend continuous improvements. Requirements Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, BIM Management, Architecture, or a related discipline. Minimum 5 years of experience in BIM coordination, BIM management, or digital engineering within construction or infrastructure projects. Experience working on large infrastructure, railway, tunnel, bridge, or civil engineering projects.
  
  

Advanced proficiency in Navisworks, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, and BIM coordination platforms. Experience with Common Data Environments (CDE), document management systems and digital project delivery. Strong understanding of BIM standards, model coordination and information management processes. Experience performing clash detection, model reviews and design coordination.
  
  

Experience with ProjectWise, ACC (Autodesk Construction Cloud), BIM 360, or similar platforms. Knowledge of IFC standards and openBIM workflows. Experience with 4D planning and construction sequencing. Familiarity with Swedish infrastructure projects and Trafikverket BIM requirements.
  
  

Experience supporting as-built documentation and digital project handover. Knowledge of construction methodologies and engineering workflows. Strong analytical, organizational and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  
  

Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and international project teams. Language Requirements Professional working proficiency in English is required. Swedish is highly meritorious due to the project's regulatory environment, documentation requirements. We Offer The opportunity to work on one of Sweden's largest and most complex infrastructure projects.
  
  

An international working environment within a leading global construction company. Long-term project involvement with significant responsibility and influence. The chance to contribute to the development of critical rail infrastructure in Sweden. Location Vagnhärad, Sweden Apply If you have the qualifications, experience, and passion for creating a safe and successful construction environment, we would love to hear from you.
  
  

Get in touch with Nicole Granlund nicole.granlund@hochtief.se, or apply directly at: https://hochtief.se/karriar/ Join HOCHTIEF and help build the infrastructure of tomorrow.

title: Senior Scientist – Clinical AI
description:
**Location** Gothenburg, Västra Götaland County, Sweden **Job ID** R-262109 **Date posted** 21/10/2026
  
Role: Senior Scientist - Clinical AI


Location: Gothenburg, Sweden


**About AstraZeneca and AISI**


At AstraZeneca, technology and science meet to change what is possible for patients. We are building a connected, end-to-end Enterprise AI engine that unites data foundations, AI technology, process reinvention, and business-facing AI to accelerate results across the whole value chain. Success depends on being an exceptional connector: you will leverage existing capabilities, promote reuse, share breakthrough ideas across geographies and functions, and focus on scaling impact rather than building in isolation.


AI Science & Innovation (AISI) sits at the centre of AstraZeneca's R&D AI transformation. Our remit is to build, buy, and deliver the AI models and agents that change pipeline outcomes, across discovery, translational science, biomarkers, and clinical development.


Within AISI, the BioPharma Clinical Development AI team is building world-class AI capability to accelerate the design, conduct, and analysis of clinical trials across our BioPharmaceuticals pipeline, in both early and late phase programmes. We partner closely with clinical development, regulatory, and biometrics teams to bring better treatments to patients faster, while adhering to the highest evidentiary standards.


**The Opportunity**


Clinical development is one of the most data-rich and decision-intensive parts of bringing a new medicine to patients. Trial design, patient selection, dose optimisation, biomarker strategy, and safety evaluation are all areas where AI and machine learning can add rigour, speed, and precision, as a powerful complement to clinical and statistical expertise.


You will work in cross-functional teams across the key BioPharmaceuticals disease areas of cardiovascular, renal, metabolic disease, respiratory, and immunology. Alongside experienced data scientists and clinical collaborators, you will apply modern AI methods to measurably advance the drug pipeline and help build reusable approaches that scale across programmes.


Foundation models, agentic systems, and causal AI are advancing rapidly, and the regulatory and methodological frameworks around them are evolving in parallel. In this role you will be hands-on at the frontier, developing, evaluating, and deploying AI methods that directly inform clinical trial design and decision-making. Every model you contribute to will eventually touch a trial that decides whether a patient gets a better therapy. That is the bar we hold ourselves to.


**What You'll Do**


* Develop and deploy AI/ML methods for clinical trials, including trial design support, dose optimisation, biomarker discovery, digital twins, predictive modelling, and safety and efficacy signal detection


* Contribute to end-to-end project delivery, from problem framing and methodology selection through to validation and adoption within study teams, with guidance from senior colleagues on more complex initiative.


* Partner with Clinical Development, Biometrics, and Regulatory colleagues to embed AI approaches into study design and decision-making


* Build reusable, well-documented data products such as pipelines, packages, and applications, with a software engineering mindset


* Apply modern methodologies including foundation models, agentic AI, generative patient models, longitudinal modelling, Bayesian inference, and causal inference, with clear evaluation criteria


* Practise data-centric AI and contribute to evaluation and benchmarking frameworks suitable for clinical and regulatory settings


* Engage with internal and external scientific communities, contributing to publications and conference presentations


**Essential Requirements**


* A degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g. Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Biomedical Informatics, Computational Biology, Physics, Engineering) at Master's, or PhD level, or equivalent experience


* Demonstrated experience in AI/ML method development, shown through delivered models, publications, open-source contributions, or applied projects, ideally in clinical, biomedical, or drug development settings


* Hands-on experience with biological or clinical data, such as molecular (DNA, RNA, protein), imaging, or clinical text (EHR, clinical notes)


* Technical capability in one or more modern AI areas, such as foundation model training and fine-tuning, Bayesian inference, temporal and longitudinal modelling, multimodal integration, model interpretability, or post-training and alignment


* Strong Python skills, experience with PyTorch and modern LLM tooling, and familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP)


* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex methods into actionable insights for clinical, regulatory, and scientific audiences


**Desirable Skills and Experience**


* Exposure to clinical development, such as trial design, biomarkers, dosing, safety, endpoints, or regulatory processes


* Experience with MLOps/LLMOps, uncertainty quantification, or clinical AI benchmarking


* Peer-reviewed publications in clinical AI, computational drug development, or machine learning


**How You Work**


* You are comfortable using, but not over-relying on, agentic AI tools to augment your work.


* You keep up with the latest AI research and try out new tools and methods without waiting to be directed.


* You put the team and the programme first, not just your individual project.


* You are comfortable with ambiguity and prefer to learn in public, prototype early, and fail forward.


**Work policy**


When we put people in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. This role is located in Gothenburg, Sweden and is not available for remote work or with travel or commuting support.


**Why AstraZeneca?**


We are investing boldly in AI and data to become truly data-led, bringing together unexpected teams to solve problems that have never been solved before. We empower scientists to experiment, prototype early, and partner credibly across ML, clinical, biostatistics, and regulatory communities. We value learning agility and technical excellence equally, and your work will directly influence trials that shape whether patients receive better therapies.


We balance the expectation of being in the office, on average at least three days per week, with individual flexibility.


**So, What's Next?**


Are you ready to build AI that matters, at the intersection of machine learning, clinical science, and real patient impact? Submit your CV and cover letter and let us explore how your expertise can help AstraZeneca accelerate the next wave of breakthrough medicines. Welcome with your application no later than **November 6, 2026**.


#ClinicalAI #DataScience #AISI #MachineLearning #DataAI #EAI


**Date Posted**


22-okt.-2026
**Closing Date**


06-nov.-2026
Our mission is to build an inclusive and equitable environment. We want people to feel they belong at AstraZeneca and Alexion, starting with our recruitment process. We welcome and consider applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of characteristics. We offer reasonable adjustments/accommodations to help all candidates to perform at their best. If you have a need for any adjustments/accommodations, please complete the section in the application form.

title: Data Center Hardware Engineer
description:
**Location**
------------


Borlänge


**Employment Type**
-------------------


Full time


**Location Type**
-----------------


On-site


**Department**
--------------


Engineering & Infra


  
**About Mistral**
-----------------


Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.


We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.


**The mission**
---------------


You will work every day on the racks that power one of Sweden's largest AI clusters.
  

Mistral's compute footprint is our single largest investment and the foundation of our AI research and engineering. We're hiring Data Center Hardware Engineers to keep our clusters healthy, safe and growing — hands-on, in the data center at the intersection of high-performance computing and physical infrastructure.
  

You'll join a small, senior team working at a scale few engineers get to experience: GPU-dense racks (next-generation platforms), high-speed interconnects, liquid-cooled systems — with new sites under development in France and beyond.
  

Hardware here is not someone else's problem. As part of a small on-site team, you carry responsibility for it end to end.


**Location:** On-site at our data center in Dalarna region.


**What you'll do**
------------------


* Diagnose & repair server and cluster hardware: CPUs, memory, drives, NICs, GPUs, PSUs and interconnect problems (switches, cables, transceivers; Ethernet/InfiniBand).
* Intervene safely — power-off/lockout, ESD discipline, pre/post-work checklists, tidy and safe work areas.
* Capture everything — photos, serials, test results; open, update and close tickets with notes the next engineer can act on.
* Manage parts — receive, label and track inventory; run RMAs and coordinate with vendors.
* Help us get better — feed recurring anomalies into monitoring, alerts and SOPs; contribute small scripts (Python/Bash) if you have those skills.
* Be a good teammate — clear status updates, honest handovers and respect for the people around you.

**About you**
-------------


* Hands-on comfort in data centers or server hardware — you can (or will quickly learn to) work cleanly in racks: rails, cabling, labeling, mounting.
* Disciplined and meticulous: checklists aren't bureaucracy to you, they're craftsmanship.
* Practical electrical basics: power-off procedures, PPE, short-circuit risk awareness.
* Basic Linux (boot checks, logs) — scripting is a plus, not a requirement.
* Physically able to work in racks (lift, mount, maneuver) in a data center environment.
* Comfortable in a 24/7 operation, including a rotating on-call with emergency response expectations.
* Driver's licence (B) for travel between our sites.

Even if you don't match every criterion
  

Many of our best hardware engineers came from research labs, telecoms, IT services or the military. If you are rigorous, curious and genuinely motivated by hardware at scale, we would be glad to hear from you — we assess demonstrated scope rather than keyword matching.

  


**Nice to have**
-----------------

* HPC/AI/cloud production experience at scale; large-fleet server install and maintenance.
* Networking fundamentals (Ethernet/InfiniBand) beyond basics.
* Vendor/RMA tooling, ticketing (Jira/ServiceNow), inventory systems.
* Python/Bash automation for checks, capture, inventory or reporting.

-----------------


We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.


For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

------------------


Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: VP Engineering
description:
*Learnster is a learning platform on a mission to change how organizations develop their people. We combine a human-centered approach with modern technology and AI to help companies build real learning cultures. More than 200 customers and over 400,000 users in 50+ markets rely on us, including ICA, Sats, Röda Korset and Omegapoint. We are profitable, growing, and have a culture people genuinely enjoy being part of.*

*Now we’re looking for the person who will take our technology to its next chapter.*

**The job**
-----------


Learnster stands on solid ground: a working platform, loyal customers and a profitable business. But big changes are coming in how we build, how we scale and how we use AI. We want you to lead them.


This is not a role where you inherit a finished roadmap and keep the lights on. You will set the technical direction for the whole company. You’ll make the platform faster for our largest customers and bring agentic development into how the whole team works. You’ll also evolve our architecture so it supports how we package and price our product. Every major technical decision connects directly to the business, and you’ll be the one making the call.


You’ll have real freedom to shape the tech organization: how the team works, how it grows, and which practices define it. The team is experienced and self-driven. What it needs is a leader who sets the direction, explains the why, and then gives people room to deliver. We’re a small company with short decision paths, so what you decide on Monday can be in motion by Wednesday.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Ownership of delivery, driving the work from discovery to launch and follow-up, in close collaboration with product management and design as well as marketing, sales and customer success.
* Leading a team of 7 highly skilled developers in Stockholm and Ukraine. The team will probably grow by 1–3 people over the coming year.
* Owning the plan for agentic development and the modernization of our platform. Our stack is currently Python/Django on AWS.
* Leading the way how tech is working with security including the standards for ISO 27001 and in the near future ISO 42001 for AI.
* Reporting directly to our CEO as part of the management team.

**What you have experience from**
---------------------------------

* Being a senior technical leader, such as VP Engineering, CTO or equivalent.
* Leading teams of at least 5 people, and ideally coaching other leaders.
* B2B SaaS, with an understanding of what enterprise customers need on security and integrations.
* Moving tech teams to agentic development.
* Working with a mature product. Refactoring or modernizing larger platforms is a strong plus.
* Building and running cloud-based solutions (AWS, Azure or GCP).
* Fluent Swedish and English, written and spoken.

**You are**
-----------

* A clear leader who delegates, motivates through context, holds people accountable and gives feedback early. You have made tough people decisions.
* Technical enough to dive into the details when it matters. You’re neither a pure people manager nor a lone coding hero.
* Pragmatic. You choose technology for the sake of the business and understand the financial consequences of architectural decisions.
* Someone who gets energy from building and changing things, not just maintaining them.
* Experienced in security work such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2. A plus, not a requirement.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* A key role in the management team of a profitable, financially stable SaaS company.
* The freedom to shape the tech organization and the platform’s future.
* An experienced, self-driven team and short decision paths.
* Flexible work arrangements (remote/on-site).
* Health and wellness benefits.
* Six weeks of paid vacation plus 3 extra free days per year.
* A culture that values diversity and promotes personal development.

**The recruitment process**
---------------------------


We aim for a fair, effective and qualitative process and hope to have a signed agreement before Christmas.

* **Screening interview:** An initial interview with our recruiter
* **Initial meet interview:** 30–45 minutes with Erik our CEO, preferably on-site. We present the role and the company and get to know you.
* **Team interview:** A deeper interview on leadership and technology, with situational questions about how you have acted in the past.
* **Case - Business and leadership:** An interview with focus on an architectural challenge, combined with leadership and business understanding.
* **Decision, references and offer.**

**We look forward to meeting you!**

title: NW Infra DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------

 **About the Opportunity**

  

Help build and run the network infrastructure that enables Ericsson’s R&D teams to develop and test what’s next. As part of the Network Evolution Unit, you’ll work across network and lab environments to deploy and operate reliable infrastructure. This is an infrastructure-led DevOps role: you’ll use software, automation and secure ways of working to improve services throughout their lifecycle.

  

This is an opportunity for a curious, hands-on problem solver. Recent graduates and candidates with up to around five years of relevant experience are encouraged to apply. DevOps candidates are welcome: you don’t need to be a security specialist, but you should care about building and operating services securely.

 **What you’ll do**

* Investigate issues in dedicated lab and network environments, find root causes and help resolve service requests and reported problems.
* Install, configure, upgrade and deploy network systems and services, supporting a reliable, business-like lab environment.
* Develop and improve automation to reduce manual tasks and make operations more consistent.
* Support both new and existing services, including maintaining and adapting configurations created by others.
* Help monitor service health, communicate performance, changes and risks, and contribute to timely incident resolution and escalation.
* Work with stakeholders and third-party vendors to support deployments and improve the services delivered to users.
* Apply security and compliance practices throughout development and operations, and contribute to reliable, well-documented ways of working.
 **What you’ll bring**

* A degree or relevant coursework in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field, or equivalent practical knowledge.
* A foundation or strong interest in IP networking, network topologies, data-centre infrastructure and network services. Relevant coursework, projects or hands-on experience are valuable.
* Some experience through work, studies, projects or internships in network or systems infrastructure, operations, or DevOps and software development. Early-career applicants are very welcome.
* A willingness to code and automate. Python is used frequently; experience with Bash, Java, scripting or other programming languages is useful.
* Familiarity with Linux or Unix, troubleshooting, and APIs such as REST.
* A security-aware mindset, collaborative approach, and clear communication skills.
  

Experience with cloud technologies, containers, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, microservices, Spring Boot, SQL or agile methods is beneficial. You don’t need to know every technology listed; curiosity and the ability to learn matter.

  

Network infrastructure is at the heart of this role. You’ll combine infrastructure knowledge with development and operations, using automation to improve delivery while helping maintain service availability and resolve issues. Security is built into the work, not a separate specialty.

title: Pre-Sales Architect - Sweden
description:
**OUR STORY:**

\uD83C\uDDEA\uD83C\uDDFA Join Scaleway and shape the sovereign cloud of tomorrow !
Since 1999, we have been designing secure, sustainable infrastructures aimed at supporting the most ambitious companies.

Historically known for our dedicated servers (Dedibox), we made a strategic shift to cloud computing in 2015. Staying true to our principles of simplicity, flexibility, and technical excellence, we have become one of the leading players in Europe in the sector.

With the rise of artificial intelligence, we have strengthened our commitment, supported by the Iliad Group, which is investing €3 billion to develop a serious, sovereign AI alternative to American and Asian giants.

Every day, thanks to our fast-growing portfolio of cloud and AI products (bare metal, containerization, serverless, AI, etc.), Scaleway proudly serves thousands of customer across the private and public sector, from corporations like France Télévisions or Hachette Livre, to fast-growing startups like Photoroom and Biolevate, to institutions like the City of Copenhagen.

\uD83D\uDCCD Our offices are located in **Paris, Lille, Toulouse, Rennes, Rouen, Bordeaux and Lyon.**  

**WHY WE NEED YOU?**

Our growth is driving us to strengthen our Solutions Architect team to **support our commercial expansion** across international markets.

Your mission will be to **guide clients** through their cloud journey with Scaleway, from discovery to migration, in order to **accelerate customer acquisition** and deliver **tailor-made technical solutions**.

**YOUR FUTURE TEAM**

We work in a collaborative and international environment where the diversity of Scalers, combined with a spirit of sharing, helps bring new projects to life every day, advancing our ambitions together.

You will be part of a team of experienced Pre-Sales Architects, paired with Account Executives, Inside Sales Representatives, Customer Success Managers, and Business Developers, all working together to serve strategic markets.

You’ll operate closely with the Sweden-based sales team while remaining integrated within the global Solutions Architecture department.

**YOUR DAILY ROUTINE**

* Act as the **primary technical contact** during the pre-sales phase for enterprise prospects and clients


* Understand **customer business needs and technical constraints** to design Scaleway-based architectures


* Support clients throughout the **discovery and migration journey** until the project transitions to support


* Conduct **in-depth technical discovery** and propose custom solutions leveraging Scaleway products


* **Collaborate with Sales, Product, and Engineering** teams to address customer challenges


* Drive **technical workshops** and proof-of-concept sessions with clients


* Maintain and **share knowledge** on Scaleway’s evolving cloud offering


* Participate in **improving internal pre-sales tools** and processes


* **Represent Scaleway** at industry events and webinars when needed


* Contribute to the **continuous improvement** of the Pre-Sales practice and documentation



**ABOUT YOU**

**HARDSKILLS**
* 3 to 10 years of experience in technical pre-sales or solution architecture roles


* Experience working with public cloud solutions and migrations


* Familiarity with container orchestration, Infrastructure as Code, or Linux systems


* Solid understanding of application/server architectures and datacenter environments


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience


* Strong communication skills in both **Swedish** **and English**



**SOFTSKILLS**
* Customer-oriented with a consultative mindset


* Ability to understand and translate complex technical requirements into scalable solutions


* Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management abilities


* Comfortable presenting to both technical and C-level audiences


* Proactive, adaptable, and eager to drive innovation

  



**WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SCALEWAY ++++**

**Full remote,** with regular visits at our Paris office.
**International environment:** With dozens of nationalities, Scaleway offers a stimulating environment where English is as widely spoken as French.
**Career & Mobility:** Our managers value internal mobility, and opportunities to transition to other entities within the Iliad Group are accessible to all Scalers.  



**Why join the Scaleway adventure?**

✔ A rich and diverse product offering: Scaleway offers over 100 public cloud products in IaaS, PaaS, and AI.

✔ A cutting-edge technical environment: Scaleway provides modern infrastructures, including high-performance bare metal servers, to tackle exciting technical challenges.

✔ Commitment to responsible cloud: Scaleway is dedicated to a more responsible cloud, with data centers powered solely by renewable energy since 2017, minimizing our ecological footprint and holding top-level certification.

**THE NEXT STEPS …**

1 - Talent acquisition interview (30 min)
2 - Head of Sales Architecture / International PSA (30 min)
3 - Technical Interview to understand your technical skills and approach to the role (45 min)
4 - CSO Interview
